svg.title: A practice becoming knowledge, and a code change reaching the application, one store per step

g.text: what the hat read, and at
writer: a leg, token at use

svg.text: a code change reaches the application
every step writes one store, by that store’s one writer; a step whose subject moved is refused, never lost
rolling back restores the source revision, not work already done in the world; a rollback is a new step
